text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Windy, thanks for the water flosser! You 
got me such an awesome birthday present!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Fufuun! I knew we should recruit that 
water flosser thing into our Toothbrushing 
Alliance!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's so true! I'll have to think 
of something to give in return too.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Nishi-shi! No need to worry about thanking 
me. More importantly, how was it?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Hurry up and tell me your thoughts after 
using it! Tell me right now!!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I can brush all the way in the back, 
leaving absolutely nothing uncleaned. It 
feels so refreshing!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
!? I-Is that all? Doesn't it hurt or 
anything...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Why did that happen~! I thought 
it'd be way more intense and surprise you 
more~! Dammit~~!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's because I'm always chewing lots 
of super-strong mint gum?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gnuuuh~! That's completely different from 
the reaction I expected!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Then think of it as getting a new goal! 
"Next time, I'll definitely surprise her!" 
like that!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
!! Y-Yeah, you're right. All right, I'll 
do my best! Next time for sure~!!
